IMMUcan._comment_crop_size: 64px, empirically best on IMMUcan (see run_virtues.py docstring history).

cHL_2_MIBI._comment_exclude_markers: VirTues's marker-conditioning has a soft channel-mask fallback for unmatched markers (no hard KeyError like Eva/KRONOS2), so only true structural stains without a biological equivalent need excluding here.
cHL_2_MIBI._comment_marker_embedding_dir: assets/example_dataset/marker_embeddings (the demo's shipped embeddings) only covers IMMUcan's 37 markers, not cHL's. The missing cHL markers' ESM embeddings were generated via virtues/utils/compute_esm_embeddings.py from UniProt-fetched FASTA sequences and added to assets/chl_dataset/marker_embeddings/ (82 files total). CD57 and TCRgd stay unembedded -- neither is a single-gene product (CD57 is a carbohydrate epitope, TCRgd a multi-chain receptor complex), so no UniProt entry applies.
cHL_2_MIBI._comment_exclude_labels: Per review: 'undefined' is a real, scored class on cHL for every method here -- kept, not excluded.
cHL_2_MIBI._comment_crop_size: Untuned for cHL -- kept equal to IMMUcan's tuned value since measured cell footprint is nearly similar (cHL mean bbox ~10.7x10.3px vs IMMUcan's ~9.5x10.6px).
